integrity: A complete proof by explicit synchronous dynamics and a good-cover nerve is supplied. Finite tests are supporting checks and not an infinite proof. Prior-work equivalence cannot be excluded for unindexed sources.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is limited to finite directed roses with \(k\ge2\), all cycle lengths \(\ge3\), and the specified near-critical all-peripheral-one initial chip distribution; no classification of arbitrary configurations or orientations is asserted.
title: Longest-petal sphere and one-birth persistence for near-critical avalanches on directed roses
